map.牛顿冷却定律（本页代码口径，指数式）：T=T∞+(T₀−T∞)×e^(−kt)（: Newton's law of cooling (this page's code basis, exponential form): T = T∞ + (T₀ − T∞)×e^(−kt) (℃, T₀ initial temperature, T∞ ambient temperature, k cooling constant in 1/min, t time in min); linked values: current temperature difference ΔT = T − T∞ (℃), time for the difference to halve = ln2 ÷ k (same unit as t). Validation: empty input in any of the four fields prompts and stops. Criteria: no fixed grading; the excess temperature decays exponentially, halving every ln2÷k, and T approaches T∞ asymptotically without ever equaling it.
